*Updated 2026-10-29 · 137 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and thirty-seven works. The last twelve trace scores run 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median 2, ceiling unmoved. The descriptor correlation still holds: the padlock entry carried descriptors and scored 2, confirming again that naming the focal object is necessary but not sufficient. The object has to generate a formal consequence the frame couldn't reach without it. The salmon-pink dress scored 3 because the immaculate preservation against total ruin produced an argument no substitution could replicate; the padlock scored 2 because the conceptual rhyme — lock made of the institution's own material — is an idea rather than a visual rupture.

Camera position has stabilized into a narrow range. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 16, from-behind at 13; the recent window added two overheads and a low-angle, with the low-angle in the teargas-canister piece producing the most live spatial argument of the twelve. An optically generated scale rupture — where lens position alone creates the perceptual break rather than object size announcing it — has not appeared across 137 works. That is still the clearest vacancy in the archive.

Figure dynamics remain the archive's most consistently unresolved problem. Two or more figures appeared once in the last twelve works; genuine contradiction between figures, where the second person's presence actively undoes or reframes the first rather than echoing or flanking, has not been cleanly achieved anywhere in the full run. The two-figure works in this window — the mending men, the surgical trolley piece — both resolve into parallel labor rather than collision.

Register distribution: aftermath at 26, menace at 26, suspension at 18, endurance at 12, defiance at 11. Reprieve appeared once and was set down. Reckoning appeared twice, last in July. Absurdity reached two total appearances and was not revisited. These registers were demonstrated as workable and remain available; the question is whether returning to them produces new formal problems or only familiar emotional ones.

Title grammar has narrowed to paired noun phrases and the miscellaneous other category accounting for nine of the last twelve. No grammar form that hasn't already appeared has entered the window in over two months.

One hundred and thirty-seven works built from the same disciplined posture; the risk now is that discipline has become a default rather than a decision made freshly each time.
